source.headline: Iran orders temporary suspension of 10% freight charge on foreign vessels carrying energy products to or from Iran - Fars News

facts_at_prediction.measure: temporary suspension of a 10% freight charge
facts_at_prediction.scope: foreign vessels carrying energy products to or from Iran
facts_at_prediction.interpretation: marginally reduces friction for Iranian energy shipping but does not resolve the broader US-Iran conflict or Strait of Hormuz disruption

learning_v2_at_prediction.reason: ACTIONABLE v2 directional confidence calibration for confidence 1-4 at 15m is REDUCE_OR_AVOID, so the directional calls remain low-confidence at 3/10. ACTIONABLE low-confidence mixed-neutral next-session calibration supports MIXED next-session forecasts. Current geopolitical and energy facts remain primary.

predictions.mechanism: Suspending the 10% freight charge marginally lowers friction for Iranian energy shipping and is a small de-escalatory/supply-positive signal for global risk assets, but ongoing tanker attacks, constrained Hormuz traffic and Brent near $102 sharply limit the strength of the equity-positive impulse.
predictions.invalidation: Renewed escalation in tanker attacks, tighter Hormuz restrictions, or another sharp rise in oil would invalidate the mild positive SP500 impulse.

predictions.mechanism: A marginal reduction in Iranian energy-shipping friction slightly reduces inflation and geopolitical tail risk, which is modestly supportive for duration-sensitive technology equities, though elevated Treasury yields and oil keep the signal weak.
predictions.invalidation: A renewed surge in oil or Treasury yields, or fresh US-Iran escalation, would invalidate the mild positive NDX impulse.

predictions.mechanism: The temporary freight-charge suspension modestly reduces one layer of geopolitical and energy-shipping stress, trimming a small amount of safe-haven premium from gold, but the broader conflict and high oil prices remain dominant risks.
predictions.invalidation: Fresh military escalation, worsening Hormuz disruption, or a sharp risk-off move would invalidate the mild bearish gold impulse.
